headlines.headline: SENATE'S PROTECT COLLEGE SPORTS ACT GAINS BIG TEN, SEC BACKING AS COURT-ORDERED FIFTH-YEAR TRANSFER WINDOW ENTERS ITS SECOND DAY
headlines.detail: The Senate is working through procedural steps on an updated draft of the Protect College Sports Act that won endorsement from the Big Ten and SEC, while NCAA president Charlie Baker continues urging Congress to pass it; separately, the special transfer portal window opened under Judge Charlotte Sweeney's fifth-year-eligibility injunction runs through Aug. 10, and Michigan State point guard Jeremy Fears withdrew from the NBA draft to return to the Spartans.

headlines.headline: LEBRON JAMES STILL UNSIGNED AS WARRIORS TURN COOL ON PURSUIT; AGENT RICH PAUL MAPS OUT REMAINING DESTINATIONS
headlines.detail: LeBron James remains the biggest name on the free-agent market with training camps a month away, as ESPN reports the Warriors are now pessimistic about landing him and agent Rich Paul is working through a shortlist of alternative destinations; elsewhere, Dallas signed Naji Marshall to a three-year, $51.86 million extension and Portland inked Jeremy Sochan for one year at $2.63 million.

headlines.headline: BIJAN ROBINSON BECOMES HIGHEST-PAID RUNNING BACK IN NFL HISTORY ON THREE-YEAR, UP-TO-$75 MILLION FALCONS EXTENSION
headlines.detail: Atlanta signed Bijan Robinson to a three-year extension worth up to $75 million, making him the league's highest-paid running back, on the same day Baltimore locked up receiver Zay Flowers on a four-year, $140 million deal; both moves came as training camps around the league logged a fresh round of injuries, including Eagles receivers Makai Lemon and DeVonta Smith sitting out Tuesday's practice with hamstring issues.

headlines.headline: ALABAMA'S QB COMPETITION TIGHTENS BETWEEN KEELON RUSSELL AND AUSTIN MACK AS FALL CAMP OPENS ACROSS THE COUNTRY
headlines.detail: Alabama head coach Kalen DeBoer said Austin Mack may hold a slight edge in the Crimson Tide's starting quarterback battle with Keelon Russell due to his familiarity with the offense, though Russell's athleticism keeps the race open with both expected to see the field in the opener; fall camp storylines elsewhere include Bill Belichick's four-man quarterback competition at North Carolina and Mario Cristobal finalizing a long-term extension at Miami.
